tradingstrategies.work/blog/bitcoin...

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
6/7

Today, close of 14 October:

→ drawdown       −34.8%
→ displacement   702 days, back to Nov 2024
→ days below     92.1% since 2010

Bitcoin gave back almost two years and still sits above nine tenths of its history. The 35% is a distance, not a discount.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
5/7

Was bitcoin at least cheap at the low? A third number: the share of all past days that closed lower.

→ low of Dec 2018   83.7%
→ low of Nov 2022   83.3%
→ low of Jun 2026   84.8%

Since 2017, no big low was cheap against bitcoin's own history.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
4/7

The reason is the rise before each fall. In 2011, price rose elevenfold in the 41 days before the high, so even a 93% drop only undid those weeks.

From March 2021 to the 2025 high, bitcoin took 1,668 days to double. Falling back into that zone costs years.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
1/7

How bad was bitcoin's 2026 bear market? By drawdown, the mildest of its big cycles: −53% against −77% to −93% before.

In time, the harshest. The June 2026 low matched a price from March 2021, further back than any low since 2010.
